description.value: Beachfront Location: Surf Front in Ahangama offers direct beachfront access with stunning garden views. Guests can relax on the sun terrace or enjoy the beachfront setting. Comfortable Accommodations: Rooms feature walk-in showers, air-conditioning, and private bathrooms. Family rooms and private entrances ensure a comfortable stay for all visitors. Dining and Amenities: The hotel provides an Asian breakfast, a lounge, and a shared kitchen. Additional facilities include a child-friendly buffet, outdoor seating area, and free on-site parking. Local Attractions: Kabalana Beach is just a few steps away, while Koggala Airport is 5 km distant.

existing_site.notes: no website, no Instagram, no Facebook, no TripAdvisor. The business exists online as one Booking.com listing plus a Google pin. Every guest it has ever had came through a channel that takes a commission, and the only description of the property anywhere is one Booking.com wrote for it.

gaps.why: there is no owner-written description anywhere — the only prose is Booking.com's generated summary. The new site needs copy written from scratch with the owner
nightly rates are live dated inventory on Booking.com, not a published price list
no site and no social account of any kind; one OTA listing is the entire web presence
five of nine quotes are truncated by Booking.com's 'Read more'
the scout did not record it, and guest accounts range from 30 seconds to 2 minutes' walk

contradictions.what: WiFi: Booking.com lists WiFi under 'Most popular facilities' but the detail line says 'WiFi is available in the rooms and charges are applicable'.
contradictions.resolution: Unresolved — paid WiFi is unusual here. Confirm with the owner before putting 'free WiFi' anywhere.
